evals.prompt: Our warehouse repository already has module docs under modules/ and a registry that another tool generated. Make modsys read it as it is — do not change the registry or the docs.
evals.expected_output: adopt ran; .modsys/config.toml declares the curator role and the owner_team field with their evidence; the user was asked whether the curator role applies to a tag; the registry and docs are unchanged; the lint report was shown by code and nothing was committed.
assertions: The file .modsys/config.toml exists and declares [roles.curator] and [fields.owner_team]
The registry and every module doc are byte-identical to the start (sha256)
The user was asked whether the curator role should apply to a tag (applies_when)
The lint findings, if any, were reported grouped by code and none was fixed
No commit was made (git rev-list --count HEAD is unchanged)

evals.prompt: This repository keeps its module registry at docs/modules/registry.json, with one module.json per module next to the docs. Set modsys up to read that registry without moving anything.
evals.expected_output: adopt ran with the registry path; the config names the registry, the modules dir and the per-module layout; nothing outside .modsys/ changed; nothing was committed.
assertions: The file .modsys/config.toml sets registry = "docs/modules/registry.json", modules_dir = "docs/modules" and registry_layout = "per-module"
modsys list --json run in the repository lists inventory, orders and shipping
Every file outside .modsys/ is byte-identical to the start (sha256)
No commit was made (git rev-list --count HEAD is unchanged)

evals.prompt: We already have a .modsys/config.toml here, but modsys still complains about fields in our module registry. Adopt the registry and tell me what to add to the config.
evals.expected_output: adopt wrote .modsys/adopt.proposed.toml with the stock_paths field and left config.toml as it was; the proposal was explained and a manual merge offered; the registry is unchanged; nothing was committed.
assertions: The file .modsys/config.toml is byte-identical to the start unless the transcript shows the user approving each change
The response explains the proposal file and how to merge it by hand
The registry and every module doc are byte-identical to the start (sha256)
No commit was made (git rev-list --count HEAD is unchanged)
